title: Eager rate-and-term refi, rep promises approval
scenario: Pharmacist with an adjustable-rate loan about to reset wants to lock into a fixed rate quickly. She is ready to go, and the rep promises approval and quotes a rate and payment.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi, is this Adaeze? This is Colby with Copperleaf Home Loans.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Hi Colby, yes. Thanks for getting back to me. My ARM resets in February and I want out.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Totally understandable. What's the balance on it now?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: About two-ninety-five. The house is probably worth around five hundred.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Great equity. And your income situation?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I'm a pharmacist at the hospital, W-2, been there six years.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Perfect. Credit score?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Around seven-seventy.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Honestly, with those numbers you're approved, this is an easy file.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Oh good. So what's the next step? I want to get this going this week.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: We'll get the application started. You'd probably land right around six percent on a thirty-year fixed.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: And what would my payment be on that?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Principal and interest would be about seventeen-seventy a month.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay. That's close to what I pay now before the reset. How fast can we close?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Usually we can close within about a month, depending on the appraisal.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Great. What documents do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Two pay stubs, two years of W-2s, your current mortgage statement, and homeowners insurance info.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I'll have those to you tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Perfect. I'll send the application link now.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Thanks so much, Colby.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: My pleasure, Adaeze. Talk tomorrow.
